Heavyarms and the others are rescuing them right now.

Hey, how long do you plan to hang around a place like this?
Have you recovered the materials we need?
Oh, the "Emerium ore"!
With this, the Ride Machine's energy supply should jump by orders of magnitude.
All that's left is the "Gundanium alloy" and weapons. Keep it up. I'm counting on you.
All that's left is the "Gundanium alloy." Keep it up. I'm counting on you.
All that's left is weapons fit for the Ride Machine. Keep it up. I'm counting on you.
Oh, the "Gundanium alloy"!
With this, the Ride Machine's armor should be vastly reinforced.
All that's left is the "Emerium ore" and weapons. Keep it up. I'm counting on you.

All that's left is weapons fit for the Ride Machine. Keep it up. I'm counting on you.
Oh, this is... the "Gaia Cannon"!
I see... This would make a perfect main gun for the Ride Machine.
All that's left is the "Emerium ore" and the "Gundanium alloy."
Keep it up. I'm counting on you.
All that's left is the "Emerium ore." Keep it up. I'm counting on you.
All that's left is the "Gundanium alloy." Keep it up. I'm counting on you.
I see... Once you've recovered them, bring them here.
...That's everything, then.
All right, let's get to work right away.
The other parts are already finished, but I'll need you to wait a little longer.
Gundam, Kamen Rider, and Ultraman... The heroes of every world pooled their knowledge and skills...
and the work went on day and night.
And then...
It's done.
Yes. This is the fruit of everyone's cooperation.
Now that's impressive!
It's quite different from the Ptolemaios.
Yeah. All we based it on was the basic internal structure.
For everything else, we adapted all kinds of different technologies.
And this time the weapons are no joke either! No way we can lose now, right?
With this, we can strike at the enemy's base.
About that, Nu Gundam...
I talked it over with Hikari and our comrades,
and we'd like you guys to take the lead in the assault on their base.
Seeing how you've fought so far, we judged that gives us better odds of winning.
I know it's a selfish request, but could you take it on for us somehow?
...All right.
We were planning to go to their base anyway.
Leave it to us!!
We'll pull it off better than you guys, just watch!
I see. Good to hear you say that. It's reassuring.
Still, you'd be stuck if we just told you to run the Ride Machine out of nowhere,
so from our side, Seravee will ride along with you.
For what it's worth, I know the Ride Machine better than anyone.
That's a big help.
Right, let me fill you in on what we know about the enemy so far.
Seems they've gotten hold of yet another world's technology.
They say it creates "the power of miracles."
That's hard to believe.
But if it's true, we've got to stop them before they misuse it.
And one more thing...
It's about this Cube's boss.
We knew the enemy's goal was the research and development of new weapons.
Going by that, we had assumed the boss here was the scientist type... In other words...

notes.note: Continues the 0246 roll-call from story_035: each party member answers 'managed somehow / we're fine' then asks about the Maganac Corps; labels in this block are reliable. Mebius (0.84) and OOO (0.90) use plain 'aa, nantoka' here (not the polite form seen in 0245), so rendered the same as the others.
Den-O Sword Form (Momotaros) 'doutte koto nee yo' = 'It's nothin'.' as in 0245#0.107. His follow-up 0.93 is the plain question in 0246 (no 'dou natten da'), so rendered as the standard line.
0.95-0.103 'I see...' one per party member; all plain form, so all with ellipsis.

Legacy mis-decode: 'tanonda zo' garbled in 0.7/0.9/0.11/0.17/0.19/0.21/0.28/0.30/0.32; read via clean twin 0230 ('Keep it up. I'm counting on you.'). Weapons not in corner brackets in this table, so left unquoted.
Legacy mis-decode of 'kakudan ni' (markedly); read as 'vastly' per 0230#0.18.
Source says 'Gundanium ore' (same slip as 0230#0.35); rendered as glossary item 'Gundanium alloy'.

SPEAKER LABELS SHIFTED: from 0.44 on, 0247 labels sit 3 rows early (label of row N belongs to row N+3, matching the clean 0230 scene). 0.45-0.47 are narration (labels Seravee/Birth/None wrong). 0.45-0.46 one sentence cut across two rows. Legacy mis-decode of 'kesshuu' (pooled) read via 0230#0.48.

True speakers by the shift: 0.48 Hikari, 0.49 Seravee, 0.50 Birth, 0.52 00, 0.53 Hikari, 0.54 Seravee, 0.55 Birth, 0.56 Nu Gundam, 0.57-0.61 Cherudim, 0.62-0.63 Nu Gundam, 0.64-0.65 Zero, 0.66-0.68 Cherudim, 0.69 Seravee, 0.70 Nu Gundam, 0.71-0.73 Cherudim, 0.74 Seravee, 0.75 Cherudim, 0.76-0.79 Seravee. Fits each line's voice (boku = Seravee, Birth's casual tone, etc.). No ! in source here, so 'It's done.'
Legacy mis-decode: read as 'kihon to naru' (basic/fundamental) internal structure.
Legacy mis-decode: the garbled kanji before 'Gundam' read as the nu symbol, i.e. Cherudim addressing Nu Gundam, who spoke 0.56. Guess, but fits the shifted labels and 0230.
0.58-0.59 one sentence cut across rows. 'Omaera ga shutai to natte' = the Hero Team takes the lead in the assault.
Cherudim asking the party: 'could you take it on for us'.
Subject 'we' restored (Nu Gundam speaking for the party).
Zero's 'makasetoke' = 'Leave it to us!!' as in 0230#0.67; trailing ? on 0.65 is a cocky 'just watch'.
Legacy mis-decode of 'genjiten' (at present) read via 0230#0.74.
Legacy mis-decode: 'kagakusha' (scientist) garbled; read via 0230#0.82. Sentence continues into story_037 (0.80).

report: 80/80. 0247 speaker labels shifted by 3 rows; speakers re-derived from clean twin 0230. Several legacy mis-decodes resolved via 0230 (tanonda, kakudan, kesshuu, kihon, genjiten, kagakusha); 0.57 garbled 'nu' is a guess (Cherudim addressing Nu Gundam). No new names.
